name: selfcheck-hls
_comment: HLS receiver self-check on the standalone target (node tools/load/target.mjs --hls --renditions 720p, then --target-state <dir>/state.json): the shim's live.m3u8 / shared-session HLS proxy / viewer sessions, the shim's /api/stats (hls.sessions) and the target MediaMTX API (ingest per path, HLS muxer output). Quality mix source 80% / 720p 20% (on-demand rendition), short holds, one headless Edge page with the real UI after stage 1. A check of the tool, not a capacity measurement.
